method: Coordinator reviews mechanisms, not titles. Source workers map repeated concepts into existing IDs; accepted new candidates preserve distinct invariants. A separate read-only cross-review found no required new-candidate merges.

proposals.reason: Unlike cell-normalization, this changes the available field structure without correcting existing values. Unlike schema-mapping, no fields are paired across two schemas. Unlike state-preserving-source-refresh, the visible change is a new collection question and its historical absence, not refreshing values from an existing source.

Unlike dashboard-slot-assembly, a new operation becomes available before it acts on retained data. Unlike pipeline-step-splice, no processing chain is rewired. The socketed stencil visibly derives a result from the existing records rather than introducing a renamed card collection.

Unlike benefit-shortfall-correction, no payment is corrected and no unpaid amount is treated as an entitlement. Unlike paired-contrast, exact context keys govern whether a numeric comparison is allowed. Unlike keyed-row-zipper, the records remain separate and open an amount ruler rather than becoming a joined dataset.

Unlike stagger-cards, the explanatory action changes a finite containing boundary after an explicit choice. Unlike queue-relief, resources occupy persistent workspace slots rather than leaving after service. Unlike dashboard-slot-assembly, no layout rearrangement or content reshaping makes the new capacity.

Unlike capability-matrix, this changes the represented measure from a discrete count to item-weighted size. Unlike bar-race, no rank changes over time and no data values evolve. Unlike population-normalized-map, no denominator division or geographic fill is used; the animation opens each counted object to expose its unequal weight.

Unlike contribution-weave, this explicitly contrasts indistinguishable recorded accounts with distinguishable later accounts and retains the historical limitation. Unlike journal-receipts, the changing information is account attribution rather than receipt status. No old event is assigned a newly inferred human author.

Unlike pooled-donor-allocation, the explanation compares two separate time-bounded receipt flows after a term changes. Unlike expiring-lease, no exclusive permission token returns to neutral custody. The expired outlet changes one conserved cash partition while equal receipts and operating outflow expose its exact effect.

Unlike schema-mapping, the starting material is a sentence rather than two field schemas. Unlike entity-spine-assembly, no source records are materialized and no unique-member set is calculated. The hero action preserves the origin of each authored concept as language becomes a proposed structure. Unlike prose-measurement-ledger, this proposes conceptual entity types and a relationship rather than extracting a subject's measurement, unit, reporting period, and qualifier. It defines a model, not an observation row.

Unlike capability-matrix, test states are derived from explicit expected and observed values rather than entered as capability claims. Unlike scan-lines, the animation exposes the comparison oracle and retains the discrepant result.

Unlike schedule-buffer, no interruption consumes reserve time. Unlike person-led-support-calendar, the central decision can leave work deliberately unscheduled, preserving a finite workload boundary instead of finding a new appointment.

Unlike contribution-weave, participants exchange the active teaching role instead of combining outputs. Unlike interpreted-case-dialogue, no statement is translated or mediated; each person demonstrates a different subject of expertise.

Unlike word-reveal, meaning comes from one person identifying another person's work and directing appreciation to them. Unlike feedback-refinement, the artifact does not need to be corrected or returned for another approval.

Unlike custody-transfer, responsibility does not move to a successor. Unlike grievance-remedy-retest, there is no complaint, repair or acceptance test; the explanatory action is requesting support and joining ongoing work.

Unlike grievance-remedy-retest, this explicitly separates downstream containment from upstream intervention and checks recurrence under resumed operation. Unlike retry-backoff, the underlying object changes before the retry.

Unlike readiness-latch, the result may move while explicitly classified follow-up obligations remain open. Unlike feedback-refinement, delivery does not imply a finished revision cycle; unresolved work retains identity, an owner and a due label.

Unlike contribution-weave, the team does not combine its outputs into one object. Unlike practice-to-work-sample, the reusable artifact itself travels to multiple coworkers. Unlike cache-reuse, different workpieces receive a repeatable procedure rather than repeated requests receiving a stored answer.

Unlike report-page-bind, a heterogeneous existing work collection changes tool without being rewritten into a new report. Unlike custody-transfer, ownership stays with the same person and source originals remain present. Unlike sealed-handoff, confidentiality is not the explanatory purpose.

Unlike component-material-return, the object is not dismantled into recovery streams or rebuilt from mixed material. Unlike revision-restore, it does not revert the whole artifact to an earlier snapshot. Only one designed seam opens around a local replacement.
Unlike pocket-inference, the model is remote. Unlike disclosure-aperture, the shared header is a schema, a plan returns, and computation visibly occurs over retained rows.
Cache-reuse compares identical keys. This changes the needed set, tests containment, and replaces one narrower relation with a wider relation without joining fragments.
Unlike queue-relief, capacity does not increase. Unlike expiring-lease, there is no timer; a global resource order prevents the illustrated circular wait.
Unlike revision-restore, the point is refusing reads of potentially partial state. It is not a rollback: only a complete reload clears invalidity.
Unlike keyed-row-zipper, this is not a two-table row join. A unique spine fixes output grain before repeated observations are aggregated, avoiding join fan-out.
Field-conflict-choice chooses among authored alternatives by human decision. This calculates a deterministic field from repeated observations under a stated rule, preserving order and missingness.

Unlike field-conflict-choice, no human chooses a winner between competing fields. The update mask structurally excludes human state, and a missing source does not mean deleting a person or closing a case.
Unlike capability-matrix, this computes a maximum over eligible grants and explains why a candidate is excluded. It is neither first-match precedence nor a blanket role inheritance ladder.

Journal-receipts starts with an existing outbox and closes obligations after acknowledgment. This explains how the obligation is created atomically with the source mutation before any network activity.
Retry-backoff repeats whole attempts. This retains a confirmed prefix and resumes by byte offset, so interruption does not restart the entire file.
Unlike schema-mapping, field names are not translated. Cell structure is recovered from two-dimensional page evidence before textual data becomes a grid.
Unlike keyed-row-zipper, labels are associated by spatial evidence rather than equal keys. Unlike location-uncertainty-boundary, uncertainty concerns document interpretation, not a position on Earth.
Unlike word-reveal, the action changes a sentence into an observation schema with explicit semantic roles, not merely typography. Value and unit cannot detach from period or qualifier.
Unlike schema-mapping, the field labels already match. The animation reveals a tabular structure concealed by repeated prose layout and preserves absent cells.
Unlike source-merge, no datasets converge and no values are combined. Output grain changes from one row per subject to one row per subject-measure pair.
Unlike revision-restore, nothing rolls back. The saved geometric locator stays fixed while a content-identity test detects drift that table numbering alone cannot detect.
Disclosure-aperture selects fields for one handoff. This also freezes a revision and shows a later live edit diverging from that immutable publication, rather than implying a live share.

Linked-parameter-rehearsal applies affine equations to quantities. This applies an equality predicate to row membership across explicit view subscriptions and preserves an independent reference denominator.
Unlike a generic data-pipeline, selection occurs before the boundary and only the matching rows are transferred. It differs from column-cache growth, which retains every row.
Population-normalized-map changes the measure by introducing a denominator. This keeps all values fixed and changes only classification thresholds, exposing a different cartographic choice.
Unlike bar-race, quantity is encoded by area without reordering. Unlike point sizing by radius, the square-root relationship is the explanatory action.
Unlike plexus-field or radial-network, cluster membership is explicit, count-conserving and reversible. These are grouped observations, not connections or epidemiological clusters.
Unlike catchment-union-gaps, a disjoint regular partition assigns every point once rather than testing coverage by overlapping service polygons. Unlike heatmap, counts are exact and cell-bounded.
Unlike disclosure-aperture, an explicit numerical release rule is applied to aggregate cells, with zero, suppression and no data distinct. No source point or location is ever exposed.
Unlike cell-normalization, rejected values are not automatically repaired. This is a coordinate-specific validation with complete dropped-row accounting and no silent removal.
Unlike GIS layer intersection, the action aligns coordinate systems before overlay. Identity is stable even though coordinate numbers change.
Unlike chart-focus-edit, actual geometry detail is reduced under a stated algorithmic tolerance. The original trace remains visible so simplification is inspectable.
Catchment-union-gaps starts from supplied polygons. This derives reachability from weighted network cost, showing why a travel-time catchment is not a distance circle.
Location-uncertainty-boundary depicts uncertainty already present in evidence. This intentionally changes a display copy under a supplied disclosure policy and labels the difference.
Spatial-grid-binning assigns each point once to an exact count cell. This spreads each contribution across neighboring cells and makes radius a visible modeling choice.
Catchment-union-gaps combines supplied coverage polygons. This derives a buffer from a distance rule and classifies points without inferring service use or routes.
Cell-normalization edits explicitly supplied characters. This changes a proposed column type in response to late evidence while refusing to change or discard any cell.

enrichments.reason: The existing bounded comparison matrix already carries the necessary row-by-row action and unknown/conditional states; another requirements chart would duplicate it.
The existing entry-to-local-impression action already explains continuity without a network. These additions clarify its use and boundaries rather than introducing another device animation.

The existing delayed-release and acknowledged-owner contract handles the responsibility question. A separate departure animation would repeat that transfer without establishing actual maintainability.
The existing matched qualitative-criteria action directly compares responsibilities. A new host diagram would add scenery without a new explanatory transformation.
A single decision with explicit conditions is already the defining action; the source adds contexts rather than a new branch mechanic.
The existing copied-subset and retained-original action explains the disclosure boundary. It should be reused rather than creating a public-dashboard card reveal with the same semantics.
The source adds scenario uses for the existing coupled-ruler arithmetic. No additional financial forecasting animation is justified by the plan alone.
The existing interval-kind distinction and fixed-scale unfolding already support this source concern. Enrichment prevents a planning haircut from being presented as statistical evidence.
The source contains choices with benefits and concessions, which the existing hinge already explains without adding an unsupported numeric optimization.

A source-to-maintainer contribution is still a bounded feedback-and-revision loop. The existing contract keeps the note, changed artifact, and authored result visible, so a separate patch-return preset is unnecessary.
The existing explicit inside/outside topic boundary is the exact required action; a product-roadmap reveal would duplicate it.
The existing two-statements-plus-context transformation resolves these apparent contradictions. New panels for open code versus curated content would repeat that mechanic.
The existing grid already supports independently stated categorical criteria. No new comparison mechanism is needed.
The existing prompt, condition and selected branch already express a constrained choice without a new value-scoring system.
The retained contributor ends and physical interlock already support this meaning.
The current author, reviewer, feedback note and changed draft already model the interaction.
An existing source sheet can be a decision record. The summary-to-source alignment needs no new renderer or input contract.
The existing context divider resolves an apparent contradiction by exposing different time horizons.
The existing hit/miss action already explains reuse; additional tier names are contextual metadata rather than a new stock algorithm.
The aperture already expresses an explicit subset leaving a boundary; AI context adds intent and caveats rather than a new action.
Same selected-field contract, with a meaningful metadata-versus-content binding.
The resident-model primitive already covers this computation boundary without a new cartridge reskin.
Existing local retention choreography is sufficient; the source/derived distinction is supplied content.
A geographic key join uses the existing equality-join mechanism; changing rows into polygon cards would be only a reskin.
The existing source peelback is already the explanatory action for inspection.
The preset already edits specific authored cell characters; source adds important edge-case constraints.
Report assembly already carries multiple source excerpts into a shareable artifact.
Existing assembly makes composition visible; it needs use-case metadata, not a duplicate dashboard preset.
All-required dependency gating is already the latch contract.
The existing four-state matrix is the clearest compact explanation of capability boundaries.
Field correspondence is already schema-mapping; entity-grain assembly is separately new.
